review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: What You'll Do Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure across AWS and on-premise environments. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure, including automated testing and deployment. Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code for scalable, multi-region infrastructures using multilevel Terraform and Terragrunt, ensuring modularity, version control, and automation.
eligibility_evidence: Design and manage complex networking solutions, including VPCs, subnets, routing, firewalls, VPNs, load balancers, PrivateLinks, Direct Connect, and AWS Secure VPN setup, as well as hybrid cloud connectivity.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We are looking for someone who can bring deep expertise and hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, containerization, networking, and DevOps best practices . What You'll Need Strong hands-on expertise in AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, CloudFormation, networking services).
